This time, every window shone, and someone stood beside him in the lantern room.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一封尚未拆开的信。路灯把空荡的街道照成淡金色，清洁车缓缓驶过，留下潮湿的反光。早餐铺里，第一笼包子冒出白汽；医院的窗仍亮着，有人等待消息。远处，一辆夜班公交停靠站台，司机揉了揉眼睛。天边尚无晨光，楼上的闹钟还没响，面包房已飘来温热的香气，新的日子正在悄悄醒来。","w03":"- Recursion means solving a problem by using the same method on a smaller version of that problem.\n- Imagine opening a box, finding a smaller box inside, and repeating until you find a toy.\n- Like reaching the toy, recursion needs a stopping rule so it does not keep going forever."}
